dataset_name: Ugly Manling Barber and Style Support Seed
source_note: Initial evidence-driven seed shortlist for NYC, Los Angeles, and Chicago. This is intentionally selective and under target counts rather than padded with weak entries. Several fields remain null where public evidence was not confidently verified in this pass.

cities.market_summary: NYC is the strongest early market for Ugly Manling. Manhattan, Brooklyn, and southeast Queens show dense named-barber booking profiles with strong beard, shave, and precision-cut evidence. The best candidates are not explicit hair-loss specialists, but several appear strong for buzz cuts, clean shaves, beard framing, and confidence-restoring reset cuts.

candidates.evidence_summary: Strong Booksy profile with 278 reviews and explicit buzz cut, beard maintenance, half shave, and full shave services. External directory snippets indicate clients value how carefully he listens and the polished finish of the cut.
candidates.review_signal_summary: High volume of named-booking reviews, strong service menu fit for shaves and buzz cuts, and repeated detail/listening signals.
candidates.ranking_notes: Best NYC fit for practical grooming resets and shaving-adjacent transitions.

candidates.evidence_summary: Booksy profile with 300+ reviews and explicit haircut plus beard trim, line up, and hot towel shave services. One standout review mentions fixing a previously bad beard cut while clearly explaining the correction.
candidates.review_signal_summary: Dense named-review history with trust and correction-oriented signals that match confidence-restoring use cases.
candidates.ranking_notes: One of the strongest Brooklyn options for practical beard framing and repair situations.

candidates.evidence_summary: Booksy reviews highlight precision, sharp fades, and hot towel/beard-related services. Secondary listing also points to strong local reputation and precision-oriented styling.
candidates.review_signal_summary: Very strong review count and repeated praise for listening and precise execution.
candidates.ranking_notes: Strong all-around barber with good fit for detail-conscious men who need reliability.

candidates.shop_address: 112-21 Guy R. Brewer Blvd, Jamaica, NY 11433
candidates.evidence_summary: Booksy listing shows Baldy with Hot Towel Beard Razor Shave, regular Caesars, beard work, and fades. The service mix is particularly relevant to shaving transitions and low-maintenance styles.
candidates.review_signal_summary: Good review density and strong service-level relevance for baldy, shave, and beard clients.
candidates.ranking_notes: High-value Queens candidate for practical maintenance cuts and clean-shave paths.

candidates.neighborhood: Brooklyn Navy Yard / Fort Greene edge
candidates.shop_address: 141 Flushing Ave, Floor 12 Suite 1232, Brooklyn, NY 11205
candidates.evidence_summary: Booksy profile with 139 reviews, haircut plus beard service, and after-hours VIP sessions. Reviews emphasize professionalism and fade quality.
candidates.review_signal_summary: Smaller review base than top entries but still strong and consistent.
candidates.ranking_notes: Useful premium Brooklyn option with a professional, appointment-driven feel.

candidates.evidence_summary: Booksy profile shows haircut plus beard/shave services and enhancement options. Reviews point to patience, care, and polished outcomes.
candidates.review_signal_summary: Good named-review count, though second-source confirmation is still thin.
candidates.ranking_notes: Promising Manhattan candidate but should be second-source verified before production.

candidates.shop_address: 309 E Houston St, New York, NY 10002
candidates.evidence_summary: Booksy shows haircut plus beard line and shave, shape up, and royal cut with hot towels. Good service fit for shaving and grooming transitions.
candidates.review_signal_summary: Good volume and relevant service mix, but not yet strong multi-source proof.
candidates.ranking_notes: Good practical LES option; should be social/profile verified later.

candidates.evidence_summary: Booksy profile includes haircut plus beard, razor shave, and clipper shave services with positive detail-oriented review language.
candidates.review_signal_summary: Healthy review count and good service alignment, but lighter corroboration outside Booksy.
candidates.ranking_notes: Good secondary Queens candidate, especially for lower-maintenance grooming needs.

cities.market_summary: Los Angeles has many named barber profiles with strong fade and beard work, but evidence is more fragmented and metro-spread than NYC. The strongest candidates skew practical rather than luxury, especially in South LA and nearby neighborhoods, which is a good fit for Ugly Manling's recommendation layer.

candidates.evidence_summary: Very strong Booksy profile with 394 reviews and explicit haircut plus beard, line up, and design-related services. Reviews repeatedly mention consistency and care with the final look.
candidates.review_signal_summary: Strongest LA review volume in this pass with high repeat-booking energy.
candidates.ranking_notes: Best current LA anchor for a trusted-quality recommendation layer.

candidates.evidence_summary: Booksy profile with 155 reviews and strong haircut plus beard/fade-taper menu. One recent review explicitly says the cut boosted confidence and self-esteem.
candidates.review_signal_summary: Excellent confidence-oriented signal with meaningful service relevance.
candidates.ranking_notes: Very strong fit for the Ugly Manling positioning, though city-boundary handling should be clarified in-app.

candidates.shop_address: 877 Francisco St, Unit 19, Los Angeles, CA 90017
candidates.evidence_summary: Booksy profile with 54 reviews plus a second profile source at Salons by JC. Services include haircut and beard, line up, and VIP grooming options.
candidates.review_signal_summary: Lower review count than top LA entries but more identity confirmation across public pages.
candidates.ranking_notes: Strong DTLA option with useful corroboration and clear men's grooming focus.

candidates.shop_address: 7500 S Main St, Los Angeles, CA 90003
candidates.evidence_summary: Booksy profile with 98 reviews, fade/taper haircut, haircut plus beard, line up, and shave services. Strong affordability and high accessibility.
candidates.review_signal_summary: Good volume and a useful service mix for straightforward men’s maintenance cuts.
candidates.ranking_notes: Good budget-friendly inclusion with strong functional fit.

candidates.evidence_summary: Booksy profile with 26 reviews, haircut plus beard services, and reviews highlighting professionalism and precision. One negative review suggests some caution but not enough to disqualify.
candidates.review_signal_summary: Mixed but still favorable profile with enough positive evidence to keep in the shortlist.
candidates.ranking_notes: Worth keeping in the seed, but not as strong as the top four.

candidates.shop_address: 8913 S Western Ave, Los Angeles, CA 90047
candidates.evidence_summary: Booksy listing includes head shave, beard grooming, and full-service grooming options. Reviews are lighter in count but positive on listening and comfort.
candidates.review_signal_summary: Small sample but highly relevant service mix for confidence-oriented grooming transitions.
candidates.ranking_notes: Interesting niche fit if the app wants to surface full-service transformation barbers.

candidates.shop_address: 7923 S Central Ave, Los Angeles, CA 90001
candidates.evidence_summary: Booksy includes beard shaping and head shave services, making the profile especially relevant to low-maintenance or shave-forward clients.
candidates.review_signal_summary: Review count is moderate, but menu relevance is unusually high for Ugly Manling.
candidates.ranking_notes: A practical and accessible inclusion for shave-adjacent recommendations.

candidates.shop_address: 7922 S Central Ave, Los Angeles, CA 90001
candidates.evidence_summary: Booksy shows haircut with mustache/goatee, beard-only service, and head shave. Review count is low, but the service mix is strongly aligned to Ugly Manling needs.
candidates.review_signal_summary: Thin evidence base but unusually relevant grooming-service menu.
candidates.ranking_notes: Keep as a low-confidence candidate pending better social or review confirmation.

cities.market_summary: Chicago has a strong middle-market barber scene with named profiles, useful service menus, and practical price points. The best candidates combine fades, beard work, and patient communication rather than purely trend-driven or luxury positioning.

candidates.evidence_summary: Booksy profile with 180 reviews and strong beard-plus-eyebrow, line up, and haircut services. One review specifically mentions excellent communication with a sensory-sensitive child, which is a strong proxy for patience and care.
candidates.review_signal_summary: High quality review signals beyond haircut quality alone; strong trustworthiness markers.
candidates.ranking_notes: Best overall Chicago fit for a trust-first recommendation layer.

candidates.evidence_summary: Booksy profile with 330 reviews and haircut with facial hair services. High demand and strong recency make this one of the safest volume-based picks in Chicago.
candidates.review_signal_summary: Very strong review count, though multi-source corroboration still needs work.
candidates.ranking_notes: A clear Chicago anchor candidate despite thinner second-source proof.

candidates.evidence_summary: Booksy profile with 232 reviews, haircut plus beard, and enhancement services. Strong repeat-booking behavior and premium presentation.
candidates.review_signal_summary: Strong rating and volume with solid service relevance, though still mostly one-source in this pass.
candidates.ranking_notes: Good premium inclusion with a modern appointment-driven feel.

candidates.evidence_summary: Booksy shows haircut plus beard and shear-cut offerings with nearly 200 reviews. There is also a separate shop-level public page that confirms the location and identity context.
candidates.review_signal_summary: Strong named-booking evidence and useful corroboration from the shop listing.
candidates.ranking_notes: A good higher-touch option for men who need a more consultative cut approach.

candidates.evidence_summary: Booksy profile with over 100 reviews, haircut plus beard service, and detail-oriented review language.
candidates.review_signal_summary: Healthy review density and clear beard-service relevance.
candidates.ranking_notes: A practical, likely reliable mid-range Chicago option.

candidates.evidence_summary: Large Booksy listing presence with haircut, lining/taper, and affordable pricing. Strong accessibility and straightforward grooming focus.
candidates.review_signal_summary: Good evidence from listing snippets, but should be upgraded with a direct profile page before launch.
candidates.ranking_notes: Useful budget inclusion if a direct detail page is later confirmed.

candidates.evidence_summary: Booksy profile with shave, beard trim, haircut, and enhancement services. Strong enough practical service fit for the shortlist.
candidates.review_signal_summary: Moderate review signal and relevant service menu, but limited corroboration so far.
candidates.ranking_notes: Solid secondary Chicago candidate for shave-forward users.

candidates.evidence_summary: Booksy shows skin fade, haircut plus beard, and eyebrow razor work. Smaller sample than top Chicago picks but still has service-level relevance.
candidates.review_signal_summary: Lightest evidence among the kept Chicago entries.
candidates.ranking_notes: Include only as a lower-confidence budget candidate until stronger proof is added.

needs_manual_verification: Any Los Angeles candidate outside Los Angeles proper but inside the metro, including Mando the Barber, Bryan_barbero11, and Bernz The Butcher
NYC candidates with only one strong public source in this pass, including Xav The Barber, Karlitosway Cut, and Jesse The Barber
Chicago candidates with good Booksy fit but thin second-source visibility, including MELLO, Matt at Mattointhecut, Yair Barber, and Louie The Barber
Any candidate where shop identity and individual identity blur together on booking platforms
remaining_data_gaps: Direct Instagram or TikTok profile confirmation for more candidates
More explicit evidence tied to receding hairlines, diffuse thinning, crown thinning, or shaving-transition expertise
Standardized neighborhood labels and city-boundary handling
A stronger consultation-quality signal based on direct review text or social captions
